instrument: Draft moratorium proposal, Raleigh City Council
summary: The mayor requested Council review of a six-month moratorium reaching data centers larger than 10,000 square feet, with a vote set for the October 6, 2026 meeting.
notes: The only floor-area threshold identified in this corpus. Every other trigger in the file is expressed in megawatts, acreage, or gallons.
confidence_note: Draft not read. Whether the threshold is gross floor area, building footprint or something else is NOT_CHECKED, and that distinction materially changes what it reaches.
